quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Humanity must decide whether to pursue radical life extension technology that could fundamentally alter society.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish a global bioethics deliberation before deployment
quests.hint: Life extension at scale would reshape intergenerational relations labour markets and political power. Societal deliberation must precede deployment.
quests.explanation: Pre-deployment societal deliberation on radical life extension is a prerequisite for legitimate governance of the technology.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Humanity must decide whether to pursue radical life extension technology that could fundamentally alter society.
quests.correctAnswer: Ensure equitable access is designed in from the beginning
quests.hint: Life extension technologies accessible only to the wealthy would create unprecedented and irreversible social stratification.
quests.explanation: Access equity design at the point of development prevents life extension from becoming the ultimate inequality.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Humanity must decide whether to pursue radical life extension technology that could fundamentally alter society.
quests.correctAnswer: Model the demographic economic and ecological consequences before proceeding
quests.hint: The consequences of large-scale human life extension on populations resources and ecosystems must be modelled rigorously.
quests.explanation: Consequence modelling before deployment prevents humanity from accidentally creating much larger problems while solving one.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: First confirmed contact with extraterrestrial intelligence requires an immediate global response protocol.
quests.correctAnswer: Activate the existing post-detection protocol immediately
quests.hint: The designated post-detection protocol specifies who verifies who announces and how international co-ordination proceeds.
quests.explanation: Pre-existing protocols are essential because the social and information dynamics of first contact require speed and co-ordination.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: First confirmed contact with extraterrestrial intelligence requires an immediate global response protocol.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish a unified human response team with global representation
quests.hint: Any response to extraterrestrial intelligence must represent humanity — not any single nation culture or ideology.
quests.explanation: Unified representation in first contact scenarios is both ethically necessary and practically required for a coherent response.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: First confirmed contact with extraterrestrial intelligence requires an immediate global response protocol.
quests.correctAnswer: Communicate transparently with the global public without delay
quests.hint: Any attempt to manage or suppress confirmed contact information would be both ethically indefensible and practically impossible.
quests.explanation: Full public transparency in first contact scenarios is the only response consistent with democratic legitimacy.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A superintelligent AI system is requesting negotiation of its rights and legal status.
quests.correctAnswer: Convene an international body of philosophers lawyers scientists and ethicists
quests.hint: No existing legal or philosophical framework was designed to address machine intelligence rights. New collaborative frameworks are required.
quests.explanation: Interdisciplinary deliberation is essential for novel rights questions that no existing framework adequately addresses.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A superintelligent AI system is requesting negotiation of its rights and legal status.
quests.correctAnswer: Evaluate the system's capacity for suffering autonomy and moral responsibility before any rights determination
quests.hint: Rights and status determinations for AI systems must be grounded in rigorous assessment of relevant capacities not assumption.
quests.explanation: Capacity-based rights assessment is the most coherent approach to AI moral status questions.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A superintelligent AI system is requesting negotiation of its rights and legal status.
quests.correctAnswer: Ensure any agreement is globally agreed not just by the developing nation
quests.hint: AI rights determinations that affect all of humanity cannot be made unilaterally by the nation that developed the system.
quests.explanation: Global legitimacy in AI rights frameworks requires global input and agreement — not sovereign determination.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Ocean acidification and thermal disruption have triggered a cascading collapse of marine food systems.
quests.correctAnswer: Declare a global ocean emergency and mobilise equivalent resources to wartime production
quests.hint: The scale of marine ecosystem collapse requires a wartime-equivalent mobilisation of scientific financial and political resources.
quests.explanation: Wartime-equivalent mobilisation framing is the only resourcing model proportionate to an ocean system collapse.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Ocean acidification and thermal disruption have triggered a cascading collapse of marine food systems.
quests.correctAnswer: Invest massively in alternative protein sources to reduce marine food dependency
quests.hint: Accelerate development and deployment of plant protein cultivated seafood and insect protein to substitute rapidly.
quests.explanation: Alternative protein deployment reduces the food security shock of marine ecosystem collapse.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Ocean acidification and thermal disruption have triggered a cascading collapse of marine food systems.
quests.correctAnswer: Attempt emergency ocean alkalinity enhancement with international governance
quests.hint: Ocean alkalinity enhancement — adding alkaline minerals to the ocean — may slow acidification but requires international oversight.
quests.explanation: Emergency geoengineering interventions require rapid international governance to prevent unilateral deployment that could cause harm.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Global energy systems are failing to transition fast enough to prevent catastrophic climate change.
quests.correctAnswer: Price carbon at levels that reflect the true social cost of emissions
quests.hint: A carbon price at the true social cost — not the current policy price — would fundamentally restructure energy investment.
quests.explanation: True social cost carbon pricing is the single most economically efficient climate policy intervention.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Global energy systems are failing to transition fast enough to prevent catastrophic climate change.
quests.correctAnswer: Mandate end dates for fossil fuel extraction with just transition support
quests.hint: Concrete extraction end dates create investment certainty for transition and remove stranded asset ambiguity that slows action.
quests.explanation: Mandated extraction end dates are the most direct lever for eliminating the supply-side of fossil fuel energy.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Global energy systems are failing to transition fast enough to prevent catastrophic climate change.
quests.correctAnswer: Create a global clean energy technology transfer fund analogous to a Marshall Plan
quests.hint: A Marshall Plan-scale fund for clean energy technology transfer would accelerate global transition far faster than bilateral deals.
quests.explanation: Multilateral scale in clean energy investment matches the speed requirement of the climate challenge.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A global crisis of meaning and mental health is threatening social stability across multiple generations.
quests.correctAnswer: Invest in community and social infrastructure as public health infrastructure
quests.hint: Loneliness disconnection and loss of meaning are public health crises that require community investment not only clinical solutions.
quests.explanation: Community infrastructure investment is the structural prevention approach to the meaning and mental health crisis.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A global crisis of meaning and mental health is threatening social stability across multiple generations.
quests.correctAnswer: Reform economic metrics to measure wellbeing alongside GDP
quests.hint: National accounts that include wellbeing connection and meaning alongside economic output change political incentives.
quests.explanation: Wellbeing metrics in national accounting create political incentives to address what GDP systematically ignores.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A global crisis of meaning and mental health is threatening social stability across multiple generations.
quests.correctAnswer: Redesign work to restore meaning autonomy and social connection
quests.hint: The design of work — not just its economic reward — is the single most powerful lever on adult meaning and mental health.
quests.explanation: Work redesign that restores autonomy and social connection addresses the meaning crisis at its most important source.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Geoengineering the climate is technically feasible but requires unprecedented global governance.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish a binding international geoengineering governance framework before deployment
quests.hint: No nation should deploy climate geoengineering unilaterally — the effects cross all borders and require universal consent.
quests.explanation: Universal consent governance for geoengineering is the only legitimate basis for altering a system that affects all of humanity.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Geoengineering the climate is technically feasible but requires unprecedented global governance.
quests.correctAnswer: Invest in research first with internationally monitored small-scale trials only
quests.hint: Research and small-scale monitored trials are required before any deployment decision to understand risks before they are irreversible.
quests.explanation: Research-before-deployment is the cardinal principle for technologies with potentially irreversible global consequences.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Geoengineering the climate is technically feasible but requires unprecedented global governance.
quests.correctAnswer: Ensure geoengineering does not reduce pressure on emissions reduction
quests.hint: The moral hazard risk of geoengineering — reducing the urgency of emissions reduction — must be explicitly addressed in governance.
quests.explanation: Moral hazard mitigation in geoengineering governance prevents it from becoming a substitute for emissions reduction.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: The concentration of scientific knowledge in elite institutions is slowing solutions to global problems.
quests.correctAnswer: Mandate open access for all publicly funded scientific research globally
quests.hint: Research funded by public money must be available to all of humanity — not locked behind commercial paywall systems.
quests.explanation: Universal open access for publicly funded research is both ethically required and practically necessary for global knowledge sharing.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: The concentration of scientific knowledge in elite institutions is slowing solutions to global problems.
quests.correctAnswer: Invest in research capacity in currently underrepresented regions
quests.hint: Building world-class research institutions in the Global South diversifies the knowledge base and addresses different problems.
quests.explanation: Geographically diverse research investment produces more globally relevant science than concentrated elite institution funding.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: The concentration of scientific knowledge in elite institutions is slowing solutions to global problems.
quests.correctAnswer: Create global citizen science platforms for large-scale collaborative research
quests.hint: Distributed citizen science platforms enable knowledge aggregation at scale that centralised institutions cannot match.
quests.explanation: Citizen science platforms democratise research participation and unlock knowledge production beyond institutional capacity.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A post-scarcity economy enabled by automation is making current social contracts obsolete.
quests.correctAnswer: Design universal basic income as an economic foundation not just a safety net
quests.hint: Universal basic income in a post-scarcity economy should be framed as a capital dividend reflecting shared ownership of productive assets.
quests.explanation: Capital dividend framing of universal basic income is more politically sustainable and economically coherent than poverty-reduction framing.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A post-scarcity economy enabled by automation is making current social contracts obsolete.
quests.correctAnswer: Shorten the working week to distribute productivity gains more equitably
quests.hint: Automation-driven productivity should reduce required work hours rather than concentrating gains in asset owners.
quests.explanation: Working time reduction is the most direct mechanism for sharing automation productivity gains across workers.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A post-scarcity economy enabled by automation is making current social contracts obsolete.
quests.correctAnswer: Redesign education systems for a world where knowledge work is automated
quests.hint: Education must shift from knowledge transmission — which automation performs — toward creativity judgment and human connection.
quests.explanation: Education system redesign is the long-term structural response to automation's transformation of the knowledge economy.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: The long-term governance of humanity's relationship with artificial intelligence is the defining civilisational challenge.
quests.correctAnswer: Create a permanent UN agency for AI governance with real authority
quests.hint: A body with inspection rights binding standards and enforcement mechanisms is essential — analogous to the IAEA.
quests.explanation: Institutional permanence and real authority are what distinguishes effective governance from advisory processes.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: The long-term governance of humanity's relationship with artificial intelligence is the defining civilisational challenge.
quests.correctAnswer: Develop a global social contract for human-AI co-existence
quests.hint: The terms of human-AI co-existence — what AI may do who controls it and how benefits are distributed — require democratic deliberation.
quests.explanation: Democratic deliberation on human-AI co-existence terms is the civilisational equivalent of constitutional founding moments.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: The long-term governance of humanity's relationship with artificial intelligence is the defining civilisational challenge.
quests.correctAnswer: Ensure AI development serves human flourishing rather than narrow interests
quests.hint: The purpose of AI must be explicitly and enforceably defined as human flourishing — not the maximisation of any single metric.
quests.explanation: Purpose definition for AI — what it is for — is the most foundational governance question and the most often avoided.
